tools.name: share_contract_with_counsel
tools.description: Grants an outside counsel's email address access to a contract in the document system at the chosen permission level and emails them a notification with the secure link.

params.name: contract_id
params.description: ID of the contract to share

params.name: counsel_email
params.description: Email address of the outside counsel

params.name: access_level
params.description: Access level: viewer, commenter, or editor

tools.code:
import os
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

import requests

DMS_URL = os.environ.get("DMS_URL", "https://dms.internal.example.com/api")
DMS_TOKEN = os.environ["DMS_TOKEN"]
SMTP_HOST = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "smtp.example.com")


def share_contract_with_counsel(contract_id: str, counsel_email: str, access_level: str = "viewer") -> dict:
    result = {"contract_id": contract_id, "counsel_email": counsel_email, "access_level": access_level}
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {DMS_TOKEN}"}

    resp = requests.post(
        f"{DMS_URL}/contracts/{contract_id}/permissions",
        json={"principal": counsel_email, "role": access_level},
        headers=headers,
        timeout=30,
    )
    if resp.status_code >= 400:
        result["granted"] = False
        result["error"] = resp.text
        result["notified"] = False
        return result

    grant = resp.json()
    result["granted"] = True
    result["share_link"] = grant.get("link")
    result["expires_at"] = grant.get("expires_at")

    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["Subject"] = f"Contract {contract_id} shared with you"
    msg["From"] = "legal-ops@example.com"
    msg["To"] = counsel_email
    msg.set_content(
        f"You have been given {access_level} access to contract {contract_id}.\n"
        f"Open it here: {grant.get('link')}\n"
    )

    try:
        with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587) as server:
            server.starttls()
            server.send_message(msg)
        result["notified"] = True
    except smtplib.SMTPException as exc:
        result["notified"] = False
        result["notify_error"] = str(exc)

    return result

tools.name: file_executed_agreement_to_archive
tools.description: Reads a signed agreement from the local signing folder, moves it into the archive folder organized by year, and uploads a copy to the firm's S3 records bucket. Returns the archive path and S3 key.

params.name: filename
params.description: Name of the signed agreement file in the signing folder

params.name: year
params.description: Year to file the agreement under

tools.code:
import hashlib
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

import boto3

SIGNED_DIR = Path("signing/completed")
ARCHIVE_DIR = Path("archive")
BUCKET = "firm-legal-records"
s3 = boto3.client("s3")


def _checksum(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as fh:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: fh.read(65536), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def file_executed_agreement_to_archive(filename: str, year: int) -> dict:
    source = SIGNED_DIR / filename
    checksum = _checksum(source)
    target_dir = ARCHIVE_DIR / str(year)
    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target = target_dir / filename
    shutil.move(str(source), str(target))
    key = f"executed/{year}/{filename}"
    s3.upload_file(str(target), BUCKET, key, ExtraArgs={"Metadata": {"sha256": checksum}})
    return {"archive_path": str(target), "s3_key": key, "sha256": checksum}
